notes: Adds missing schema/contract and integration coverage for token lifecycle.

GPTR-F-002-S58.title: Token Schema and Storage Contract
GPTR-F-002-S58.description: Define the canonical schema for bearer tokens including token_id, hashed_token, issued_at, expires_at, status (active/revoked/expired), rotation_parent_id, and audit metadata. Implement storage contract in MongoDB aligned with existing GPTReader access patterns.
GPTR-F-002-S58.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/gpt_reader.py; Code/Shared/brain_auth.py; GAP: No formal token lifecycle schema exists

GPTR-F-002-S59.title: Token Rotation Core Logic
GPTR-F-002-S59.description: Implement rotation logic that generates a new token, links it to the prior token via rotation_parent_id, and invalidates or sunsets the prior token based on policy. Ensure atomicity to prevent dual-valid tokens beyond allowed overlap window.
GPTR-F-002-S59.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: Rotation not implemented in current bearer token validation

GPTR-F-002-S60.title: Expiration Enforcement in Auth Middleware
GPTR-F-002-S60.description: Enhance bearer token validation to enforce expires_at checks on every request, rejecting expired tokens and updating status to expired when detected. Integrate with existing auth flow used by GPTReader.

GPTR-F-002-S61.title: Secure Token Hashing and Comparison
GPTR-F-002-S61.description: Implement secure hashing (e.g., SHA-256 or stronger) for stored tokens and constant-time comparison during validation to prevent token leakage and timing attacks. Replace any plaintext token handling in current flow.
GPTR-F-002-S61.evidence: Code/DataPipelines/auth.py; GAP: Token storage security not explicitly defined

GPTR-F-002-S62.title: End-to-End GPTReader Token Lifecycle Integration
GPTR-F-002-S62.description: Integrate lifecycle management into GPTReader request flow ensuring issued, rotated, expired, and revoked tokens are enforced consistently across all read operations, including audit logging and SIT alignment.
